name: social-strategy-state-validator
description: Patch J-3a + Patch O enforcement: schema-validates every Write/Edit targeting `*/research/social/*/state.json` against state-schema.json. Blocks invalid writes with a specific violation reason. Non-bypassable — runs in openclaw runtime, not in the LLM reasoning loop.

hooks.name: validate-state-write
hooks.description: Intercepts Write/Edit tools when params.target ends in /state.json under research/social/. Parses proposed content, validates against state-schema.json, returns { block: true, blockReason } on failure.
